name: Merlin 1D Vacuum (MVac)
summary: Vacuum-optimized variant of the Merlin 1D powering the Falcon 9 second stage.
function: Delivers high-efficiency orbital insertion delta-v in near-vacuum with a large expansion-ratio nozzle extension and dual-redundant TEA-TEB restart capability.
materials: Regeneratively cooled chamber mated to a thin-walled radiatively cooled niobium alloy (C-103) nozzle extension that glows bright orange during burns.
history: Upgraded alongside Merlin 1D Block 5 to 981 kN (220,500 lbf), enabling heavy GTO and direct-GEO insertions and reliable multi-restart orbital maneuvering.
